name: Spirit Of The Lord
overview: The Spirit of the Lord is depicted in Scripture as the anointing presence of God that empowers believers for ministry and transformation, as seen in Isaiah 61:1 where the Spirit enables the proclamation of good news and freedom. Jesus describes the Spirit as the Spirit of truth and Comforter who dwells within believers, teaching and guiding them into all truth (John 14:17, 14:26, 16:13). The Spirit also plays a vital role in salvation and sanctification, as Peter teaches that receiving the Holy Ghost follows repentance and baptism (Acts 2:38), and Paul explains that the Spirit brings life and freedom from sin and death (Romans 8:2).
